card.title: HEINKEL HE 115
card.text: When this unit attacks, add a SPOILS OF WAR to your hand.
card.flavorText: The Heinkel He 115 was a German seaplane that was in the service of the Luftwaffe during WWII. The He 115 was first introduced in 1939 and was used as a torpedo bomber in anti-shipping operations, but also as a reconnaissance and minelaying aircraft. The He 115 was lightly armed and served best in its operations against the Allied Arctic convoys since they didn’t have air cover, but this did not last long. Once the convoys started to appear with escort carriers and long range heavy fighters such as the Petlyakov Pe-3bis the Luftwaffe lost its air superiority over the convoys. A total of 138 Heinkel He 115’s were built, including quite a few variants.
